bindings.definition: Names of persons, families and organisations use agent names.
A shared place uses place names rather than agent names.
A place's parent is a containing place.
Coordinates of the place, latitude then longitude.
A place's outside identifiers, each from a registered authority list, read on its own pages and carried only on that evidence.
One outside identifier of a place.
The identifier as its authority writes it.
The registered source an identifier comes from names its identifier type; an export makes one identifier type for each such source.
Who added an identifier, and the day it was read on its authority's own pages.

mapping.reason: RiC-O's isEvidencedBy has Relation as its domain, and an Identifier is an Appellation, so the reading that justifies an identifier has no pinned term.

bindings.definition: A registered source's host: every address cited from it, or given for an identifier of it, is on that host or a subdomain of it.

mapping.reason: Neither EHRI nor RiC-O 1.1 records the web host a source's records are served from.

bindings.definition: A sourced fact with a place, with its citations and its evidence confidence, is a place relation from the place to the fact's subject; one per source's statement, never merged.
A fact's evidence confidence is the certainty of the relation its statement maps to.
Written only in an export, from the person's preferred accepted death statement; never stored, and never from a disputed or proposed one.
Written only in an export, from the person's preferred accepted death statement; never stored, and never from a disputed or proposed one.

A main person participates in the life event.

mapping.reason: Neither EHRI nor RiC-O expresses the site's permission to display a relative under its living-person rule.

A section groups content items under a printed heading.
A section includes its content items.

Connect a content item or section to either title.

The words of a title.

Connect a content item to what it is about.
A person in the shared record.
A family in the shared record.

A city in the shared record.
A region in the shared record.
A country in the shared record.
An organisation in the shared record.

mapping.reason: Neither EHRI nor RiC-O defines an address combining a picture key, native pixel box and the words read there.

bindings.definition: Exact source text and printed addresses preserve the basis of a translation or supplied title, including after a rereading.

mapping.reason: EHRI and RiC-O source relations do not preserve the exact text and printed addresses used for a particular reading.

bindings.definition: An attributed English rendering of printed text pinned to the exact text it was made from.

mapping.reason: Neither EHRI nor RiC-O has a term combining a translation with the exact source reading and its printed addresses.

bindings.definition: Records whether a person or a model wrote a supplied title or translation, reusing production attribution.

mapping.reason: RiC-O AuthorshipRelation describes an author relation, not the site's attribution value with person-or-model kind, writer and day.

bindings.definition: A mention joins a shared person to a content item with roles, pinned to located words or whole printed regions when the words are unlocated; a mention alone does not assert that the person is its subject.

mapping.reason: RiC-O subject relations do not express a named person's printed occurrence, address and role without asserting that the content item is about them.

bindings.definition: IssueMention.address_grain distinguishes words with a located printed name from regions with a null printed name and exact whole-region addresses.

mapping.reason: Neither EHRI 0.2.0 nor its RiC-O 1.1 version defines whether a mention locates name words or only whole printed regions.

bindings.definition: One storage document joins the production sourced facts, sources and identities across issues.

mapping.reason: EHRI RecordSet groups record resources; it does not describe this application's single storage file combining identities, sourced facts and relations.

bindings.definition: Identifies whose statement a production fact is, including a family or relation.

mapping.reason: RiC-O relation endpoints do not specify the subject_id field attaching a production fact to a person, family or relation.

bindings.definition: Distinguishes structured facts, prose and image paths without approving their publication.

mapping.reason: Neither EHRI nor RiC-O defines this site's distinction between a structured fact, retained prose and an image path.

bindings.definition: Proposed is accepted plus pending review; accepted is accepted plus approved review; doubted is disputed; rejected is rejected. Attribution and review retain who said so.

mapping.reason: RiC-O relationState does not define this site's combinations of claim status and review or who set them.

bindings.definition: Full text, block breaks and block references are copies for the site, rebuilt from the physical source.

mapping.reason: Neither EHRI nor RiC-O defines the rebuilt full-text copies, Unicode offsets and block references used by this site.

bindings.definition: Groups the four issue documents for reference validation without copying shared persons into them.

mapping.reason: EHRI RecordSet describes a collection, not this application's four-document value for validating joins.
